items.question: Renew the analytics vendor at $18k/yr, or drop to the free tier and lose historical data?
items.why_you: Money, and a judgement about whether the history is worth keeping. Neither is in the record.

options.label: Renew
options.consequence: $18k/yr, history preserved, auto-renews again in 12 months

options.label: Free tier
options.consequence: $0, 90-day retention, existing history deleted at switch

options.label: Export then drop
options.consequence: $0 after one month, history kept as our own files, ~2 days of work

items.recommend: Export then drop, unless anyone actually queried data older than 90 days this year. I cannot tell from here whether they did.
items.if_ignored_30d: Auto-renews on 2026-10-14 and the decision is made for you.

items.question: The first-run screen reads as a warning. Should it?
items.why_you: Taste. I can make it friendlier or keep the caution, and I cannot tell which is right for your users.

options.label: Keep the caution
options.consequence: fewer people start, the ones who do know what they signed up for

options.label: Soften it
options.consequence: more starts, more support questions later
